name: Lido
description: Liquid staking for Ethereum and Polygon. Daily staking rewards, no lock ups.

methodology.UserFees: Lido takes 10% fee on users staking rewards
methodology.Fees: Staking rewards earned by all staked ETH
methodology.Revenue: Staking rewards earned by all staked ETH
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Lido applies a 10% fee on staking rewards that are split between node operators and the DAO Treasury
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Staking rewards earned by stETH holders
methodology.HoldersRevenue: No revenue distributed to LDO holders
